decks.notes: The deck focuses on using artifacts to create a fast and aggressive playstyle. By quickly enchanting artifacts with Ensoul Artifact and using cards like Shrapnel Blast and Torch the Tower to deal damage, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with direct damage and creature destruction. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional support to the deck's strategy. The combination of artifact creatures and direct damage spells creates a high-pressure gameplay that aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can establish their own board presence.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Extinction Event. The deck also takes advantage of cards like Waste Not and Liliana of the Veil to generate value and grind out the game. With powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaervek, the Punisher, the deck aims to control the game and win through gradual attrition. The mana base is tailored to support the deck's strategy and provide consistency in casting spells.

This deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Aetherflux Reservoir, and various creatures like Lunarch Veteran and Wildgrowth Walker. By carefully tutoring for key pieces with cards like Chord of Calling and Fauna Shaman, the deck can quickly generate a large amount of life and deal damage with Aetherflux Reservoir. The deck also includes cards like Collected Company and Return to the Ranks to help refill the board and maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on casting spells to quickly bring out Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard while disrupting the opponent's gameplay with efficient removal and countermagic spells. It also utilizes card draw and looting effects to maintain a consistent stream of spells and fuel the Phoenix's recursion ability. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass provides additional card advantage and potential for explosive turns. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of cheap spells and evasive threats, maintaining pressure while controlling the board.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix into play and utilize cheap spells to trigger its ability, allowing it to attack and deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards that can draw additional cards and protect the creatures, as well as cards that can deal direct damage to the opponent. The overall strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent by consistently summoning Arclight Phoenix and keeping the board in your favor.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes using cheap spells like Consider, Opt, Lightning Axe, and Ledger Shredder, then bring them back to the battlefield for aggressive attacks. The deck also includes support cards like Sleight of Hand and Picklock Prankster to help dig for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provides additional threats on the battlefield, while cards like Fiery Impulse and Spell Pierce help control the game and protect your creatures.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and controlling the board through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with removal spells like Fatal Push. It also incorporates cards like Waste Not and Hostile Investigator to generate advantage from the opponent's discarded cards. The win conditions include powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Liliana of the Veil, along with Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal. The deck aims to grind out the opponent through resource denial and incremental advantage, ultimately overwhelming them with its powerful threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal, and card advantage to outlast opponents. The goal is to stall the game until you can establish a dominant board presence with powerful cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Yorion, Sky Nomad. By utilizing a combination of permission spells, board wipes, and card draw, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The win condition is to gradually wear down the opponent's resources while building up your own advantage through careful card selection and strategic play.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combination of Amalia Benavides Aguirre with other creatures such as Deep-Cavern Bat, Dina, Soul Steeper, and Sentinel of the Nameless City to generate life gain and trigger abilities that synergize with Aetherflux Reservoir. The deck also includes cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company to search for key pieces and maintain board presence. By gaining a significant amount of life and setting up the right board state, the deck aims to win through a powerful combo with Aetherflux Reservoir.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, which can then be brought back to the battlefield for a powerful aggressive strategy. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Ashiok, Dream Render and Galvanic Iteration to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a balance of card draw, removal, and powerful threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly. The key strategy is to efficiently cycle through the deck, fill the graveyard, and bring back Arclight Phoenixes for repeated damage.

The deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive strategy using creatures like Imodane's Recruiter, Knight-Errant of Eos, and Venerated Loxodon. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helps disrupt the opponent's spells, while cards like Gleeful Demolition and Resolute Reinforcements offer additional support and removal. The mana base is optimized to support the aggro strategy with cards like Needleverge Pathway and Inspiring Vantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a consistent stream of threats and efficient combat tricks.

The main strategy of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game through countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' plans with cards like Dovin's Veto and Supreme Verdict, while also generating value through cards like Memory Deluge and Mazemind Tome. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value by blinking permanents for additional ETB effects. Overall, the deck focuses on slowing down the game and out-valuing opponents to secure a win.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Vein Ripper, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, the deck seeks to quickly pressure opponents and disrupt their game plan with Thoughtseize and Duress. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional threats to overwhelm opponents. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, providing the necessary colors to cast spells efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to be proactive and imposing in the early game to secure a fast victory.

This deck utilizes Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the central card to enable a control strategy. The deck includes a variety of multicolored spells to maximize Niv-Mizzet's ability to draw cards and generate card advantage. The companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, provides additional value by flickering permanents for added control options. By prioritizing multicolored spells and utilizing Niv-Mizzet's ability effectively, the deck aims to control the game through card advantage and removal spells, ultimately outvaluing the opponent and securing the win.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and resource denial through cards like Waste Not and Geier Reach Sanitarium. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game. The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption, removal, and resource denial to outvalue and outlast the opponent.

The deck is focused on using a variety of control spells and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. The key strategy is to use Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful card advantage engine, allowing the player to draw and play multiple cards each turn. The deck also includes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional value by blinking permanents for extra card advantage. With a flexible mana base and a mix of powerful threats and answers, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a longer game.
